'''Tierce Martano''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gambling/Legends|gambler]] who lived during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:WYG" />

==Biography==
{{Quote|One of the investigators made contact with the...gentleman... who may be harboring this traitor.''"<br />"''Why don't you go in and extract him?''"<br />"''Let's just say that it's complicated. We need to do this with diplomacy.|[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Jevan Monsul|Monsul]] and a spacer|<ref name="SWG:WYG" />}}
Tierce Martano was a wealthy and influential man. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], he was well respected by both the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. He owned a luxurious [[Martano estate|vacation estate]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] moon of [[Rori/Legends|Rori]].<ref name="SWG:WYG" />

[[File:MartanoEstate2.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Black Sun enforcers besieging the Martano estate.]]
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] by the name [[Cal Handro]], an old [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] friend of Tierce Martano,<ref name="SWG:WYG" /> was attacked in the [[Naboo system/Legends|Naboo system]] and crash-landed on Rori. The man was shipping a new kind of [[Syren spice|spice]] for the Rebels when his [[Transport/Legends|transport]] was shot down. Handro survived to the crash but was attacked by [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] henchmen who wanted to steal the spice.<ref name="SWG:MtYBF">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=other}}Quest: "More than You Bargained For"</ref> The smuggler successfully escaped the Black Sun and, after a long walk in the wilderness, eventually arrived at Martano's vacation estate. Tierce Martano accepted to hide the pilot in a safe house nearby.<ref name="SWG:WYG" />

The Black Sun later discovered that Cal Handro took shelter at the Martano estate. The criminals did not attack directly Martano but besieged the building. In order to get rid of the Black Sun, Martano contacted both the Empire and the Rebel Alliance, namely [[Officer/Legends|Officers]] [[M'Kae/Legends|M'Kae]] and [[Wolff Kalos]], to negotiate information about the pilot's location. However, before he could get an answer, a fight erupted between the Black Sun henchmen and a group of spacer who were also searching for the missing pilot. Martano was rescued by the spacers who eliminated all Black Sun forces. As the gambler wished to get rid of Handro as soon as possible, he eagerly accepted to give the location of Handro to the spacers. Tierce Martano also gave to the spacers the names and locations of Officers M'Kae and Kalos so the spacers could choose to hand over the smuggler to either the Empire or the Rebellion.<ref name="SWG:WYG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tierce Martano was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]].<ref name="SWG:WYG" /> The game was shut down on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Tierce Martano was added to the game with the fourth chapter of the "[[W:c:swg:Secrets of the Syren|Secrets of the Syren]]" quest line, released with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 21 Notes for 4 August 2005|Publish 21]]", on [[August 4]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> The "Secrets of the Syren" story arc was removed from the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 1|Chapter 1]]," published on [[June 8]], [[2006]], due to the major changes planed for Rori with the introduction of the [[Battle of Restuss]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter Archive 2006">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64186&resource=publish|text=Chapter Archive 2006}}</ref>
